facts.why: The turkey curry buffet is Bridget's parents' annual party, not Una Alconbury's. Wikiquote has 'my mother's annual turkey curry buffet' and Wikipedia says the parents' party.
The host is Bridget's mother Pamela Jones, not Una.

facts.text: Una Alconbury's New Year's Day turkey curry buffet.
facts.why: Same mix-up: the party is Pamela Jones's. Una is a family friend who is there.
facts.fix: Pamela Jones's New Year's Day turkey curry buffet.

facts.text: Dear diary. Made blue soup by accident. Guests polite. Eating the leftover chocolate in bed, which is fine.
facts.why: Invented diary entry. The blue soup is real (string tied round leeks and celery), but the dinner scene is not ended this way. Mark's real line: 'No, but blue is... good. If you ask me, there isn't enough blue food.'
facts.fix: No, but blue is... good. If you ask me, there isn't enough blue food.

fix_note.text: No, but blue is... good. If you ask me, there isn't enough blue food.

vibe.verdict: The food is right (blue soup, marmalade, omelettes) but the turkey curry host is wrong three times. The diary page text is clipped at 'be a better'.
